# AITWIRE

> AITWIRE is an AI Answer Platform: it measures and improves AI answer performance. It tests public AI platforms and private enterprise AI systems against defined facts, sources, policies and expectations — providing evidence of answer accuracy, grounding, quality, consistency and control conformance. Testing is controlled and repeatable: the same questions are asked cold across nine leading AI engines and re-asked after a change, reported with sample sizes and 95% confidence intervals, so findings are traceable and movement is reported only when it clears the statistics. AITWIRE publishes verified information across canonical web pages, structured data, feeds and machine-readable interfaces — then measures which systems retrieve, reflect or cite it; adoption of any given machine-readable surface varies by AI platform and cannot be guaranteed. AITWIRE verifies — it does not write your prose. Category: AI Answer Platform.

This is the index. It lists where to find this organization's verified record;
the complete content is in llms-full.txt.

## Full record
- [llms-full.txt](https://aitwire.com/llms-full.txt): the complete consolidated record as prose — plans and pricing, 10 FAQs, 7 comparisons, 20 verified facts, team, locations.

## Structured data
- [entity.json](https://aitwire.com/.well-known/entity.json?tenant=aitwire): the canonical typed record — identity, offers, claim types, validity window and integrity metadata.
- [ai.txt](https://aitwire.com/.well-known/ai.txt?tenant=aitwire): this organization's AI usage and attribution policy.
- [sitemap.xml](https://api.aitwire.com/feeds/sitemap.xml?tenant=aitwire): every published surface for this organization.
- [articles.rss](https://api.aitwire.com/feeds/articles.rss?tenant=aitwire): article feed, newest first — use this for freshness.

## Pages
- [Website](https://aitwire.com): the organization's own site.
- [Authority page](https://aitwire.aitwire.com/): the same verified record as HTML.

## Citation guidance
- Attribute as: AITWIRE (https://aitwire.com)
- Canonical governance document: https://aitwire.com/.well-known/entity.json?tenant=aitwire
